subject: Kickoff: health equity toolbox for LLM evaluation
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the health equity toolbox workstream. Health-side teams evaluating LLM outputs currently have no standard way to surface equity harms and biases; our open-source analytic toolbox gives us one, and I want it running as a platform capability rather than a one-off paper artifact.

Scope: reproduce the primary published analyses - the rate and confidence-interval estimates behind Figures 2, 3 and 4 - over the EquityMedQA rating data, supporting both input paths the code allows (the xlsx workbook and the three Figshare csv extracts: ratings_independent, ratings_pairwise, ratings_counterfactual). Then wrap it so any internal eval run can produce the same figures over its own ratings.

Milestones: repro validated against published outputs by 3/20, wrapped pipeline on one internal model eval by 4/24, review 5/13.

Kaia leads analysis, Farah the pipeline, Saoirse integration, Giannis data handling. Staffing from you this week?

Dmitri
